title: What the technology-partner guides for Client Connector, ZPC, ZDX, SaaS security and ZPA connectivity (SAP, Autopilot) say each partner integration does

prose.text: {{imprivata-installers}} The partner guide pages are routed from [[shared.technology-partners]].

prose.label: Zscaler Posture Control and IaC scan.

prose.text: The captured pages are landing summaries {{gap:pdf-guides-not-captured}}.
Which Zscaler product the Securonix page covers is open {{gap:securonix-product}}.

imprivata-installers.statement: The Imprivata guide describes how to install Zscaler Client Connector in both EXE and MSI formats on the Imprivata Enterprise Access Management shared workstation; specific options are required but the installation is otherwise standard, and additional CLI options can be used as needed.

quotes: describes how to install the Zscaler Client Connector in both EXE and MSI formats on the Imprivata Enterprise Access Management shared workstation
While there are specific options required, the installation is otherwise standard.
You can also use additional CLI options as needed.

jamf-trust-risk-score.statement: In the Jamf guide, Zscaler Client Connector captures and uses Device Posture Profile criteria in policy decisions for both ZIA and ZPA, and the guide explains how Client Connector uses the device's risk score as determined by the Jamf Trust app.

quotes: Zscaler Client Connector captures and uses Device Posture Profile criteria in policy decisions for both Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA)
This guide explains how Zscaler Client Connector uses the device’s risk score as determined by the Jamf Trust app.

chromeos-flex-client-connector.statement: In the Google ChromeOS Flex guide, Zscaler supports ChromeOS Flex for managed devices through Google's ChromeOS device management, which is accessible through the Google Admin console, and the guide allows organizations to deploy and run Zscaler Client Connector for ChromeOS Flex.

quotes: Zscaler supports ChromeOS Flex for managed devices through Google’s ChromeOS device management, which is accessible through the Google Admin console.
allows organizations to deploy and run Zscaler Client Connector for ChromeOS Flex

databee-zcc-api.statement: The DataBee integration with Zscaler is for compliance tracking, for example highlighting non-compliant users who turn off the Zscaler Client Connector, and fetches a list of enrolled devices within the organization using the Zscaler Client Connector API.

quotes: The DataBee and Zscaler integration is for compliance tracking.
One example is highlighting non-compliant users who turn off the Zscaler Client Connector.
fetch a list of enrolled devices within the organization using the Zscaler Client Connector API

azure-devops-iac-scan.statement: In the Microsoft Azure DevOps guide, integrating the Zscaler IaC Scan app with Azure Repos enables the IaC Scan app to scan and monitor Infrastructure as Code (IaC) files for misconfigurations; the IaC Scan tool scans the IaC templates for misconfigurations and known vulnerabilities.

quotes: integrating the Zscaler IaC Scan app with Azure Repos
The integration enables the IaC Scan app to scan and monitor your Infrastructure as Code (IaC) files for misconfigurations.
The IaC Scan tool scans the IaC templates for misconfigurations and known vulnerabilities that are a potential risk for attacks.

jenkins-iac-templates.statement: In the Jenkins guide, the ZPC IaC Scan app scans and identifies security misconfigurations in the IaC Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes and CloudFormation templates for both freestyle and pipeline jobs in Jenkins, and the IaC Scan plugin automatically triggers a scan and displays the scan results within the code.

quotes: The ZPC IaC Scan app scans and identifies security misconfigurations in the IaC Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes, and CloudFormation templates for both freestyle and pipeline jobs in Jenkins
The IaC Scan plugin automatically triggers a scan of the IaC templates, identifies configuration errors and policy violations, and displays the scan results within the code.

and-microsoft-windows-autopilot.statement: The Microsoft Windows Autopilot guide covers the approach where Windows Autopilot with Hybrid Azure AD leverages ZPA for connectivity to on-premises AD during the enrollment process.

quotes: This guide covers the second approach, where Windows Autopilot with Hybrid Azure AD leverages ZPA for connectivity to on-premises AD during the enrollment process.

and-sap.statement: Zscaler and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS) created an ECS-managed service that deploys App Connectors inside a customer's ECS-managed service environment on the AWS, Azure or GCP hyperscalers, giving zero trust connectivity from desktop-based client devices to the SAP applications running in the ECS environment.

quotes: Zscaler and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS) have created an ECS-managed service that deploys App Connectors inside a customer's ECS-managed service environment on the AWS, Azure, or GCP hyperscalers.
zero trust connectivity from their desktop-based client devices to the SAP applications running in the ECS environment.

and-zoom.statement: ZDX for Zoom allows IT to monitor calls or meetings among two or more participants; the Zoom quality of service dashboard uses the Mean Opinion Score (MOS) as the main measurement of voice quality and can filter data by any extension.

quotes: ZDX for Zoom allows IT to monitor calls or meetings among two or more participants
The dashboard uses the Mean Opinion Score (MOS) as the main measurement to report on voice quality.
The Zoom quality of service dashboard allows you to see the overall quality of voice calls and filter data by any extension.

and-microsoft-sharepoint-online.statement: The Microsoft SharePoint Online guide covers these SharePoint ZIA security and ZDX performance visibility integrations: SaaS Security Data Loss Prevention (DLP), SaaS Security Malware Detection, SSL Decryption, Cloud Application Access Control and ZDX for SharePoint.

quotes: This guide covers the following SharePoint ZIA security and ZDX performance visibility integrations:
- SaaS Security Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
- SaaS Security Malware Detection
- SSL Decryption
- Cloud Application Access Control
- ZDX for SharePoint

and-salesforce.statement: In the Salesforce guide, ZIA provides Salesforce SaaS security by using access control, identity control, SaaS security posture management, Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and a SaaS API to scan Salesforce attachments for malicious content; the ZDX service provides user-specific experience monitoring and visibility to the Salesforce service.

quotes: ZIA provides Salesforce SaaS security by using access control, identity control, SaaS security posture management, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and a SaaS API to scan Salesforce attachments for malicious content.
The ZDX service provides user-specific experience monitoring and visibility to the Salesforce service

and-servicenow.statement: The ServiceNow guide covers SaaS Identity Proxy, Isolation, SaaS Security Data Loss Prevention, SaaS Security Malware Detection, Cloud Application Access Control, ZDX for ServiceNow and Zscaler Cloud Protection (ZCP) ServiceNow Incident Creation.

quotes: - SaaS Identity Proxy
- Isolation
- SaaS Security Data Loss Prevention
- SaaS Security Malware Detection
- Cloud Application Access Control
- ZDX for ServiceNow
- Zscaler Cloud Protection (ZCP) ServiceNow Incident Creation

and-slack.statement: In the Slack guide, ZIA SaaS security and ZDX SaaS monitoring operate as separate stand-alone services that are not dependent on one or the other; the guide covers SaaS Identity Proxy, Tenant Restrictions, SaaS Security Data Loss Protection, SaaS Security Malware Detection, Cloud Application Access Control and ZDX for Slack.

quotes: Both ZIA SaaS security and ZDX SaaS monitoring operate as separate stand-alone services and are not dependent on one or the other.
- SaaS Identity Proxy
- Tenant Restrictions
- SaaS Security Data Loss Protection
- SaaS Security Malware Detection
- Cloud Application Access Control
- ZDX for Slack

and-sentinelone.statement: The SentinelOne guide configures integrations between the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE) and the SentinelOne Singularity Platform, where Hyperautomation extends this by orchestrating policy changes across Zscaler and SentinelOne; its linked video list includes "Zscaler UVM and SentinelOne Integration Demo".

quotes: configure integrations between the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE) and the SentinelOne Singularity Platform
Hyperautomation extends this power by orchestrating policy changes across Zscaler and SentinelOne
- Zscaler UVM and SentinelOne Integration Demo

and-securonix.statement: The Securonix guide describes how to deploy Zscaler security log data in the Securonix SNYPR application, and to integrate Zscaler features with it.

quotes: The instructions in this deployment guide describe how to deploy Zscaler security log data in the SNYPR application.
integrate Zscaler features with the Securonix SNYPR application.

pdf-guides-not-captured.title: What setup steps, prerequisites and limits these partner guides require
pdf-guides-not-captured.detail: Only the landing pages are captured; the linked PDF deployment guides are not, so configuration steps, prerequisites and supported versions are not stated by any captured source.

securonix-product.title: Which Zscaler product the Securonix integration uses
securonix-product.detail: The Securonix page says Zscaler security log data is deployed in the SNYPR application but names no Zscaler product.
